import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Data Cleaning and Feature Engineering
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)
df['Occupation'] = df['Occupation'].str.replace(' ', '\n') # for better tick labels

# Visualization
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 16))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Health and Sleep Analysis', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level, influenced by Sleep Disorder
palette1 = {'None': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'}
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(150, 500),
    palette=palette1,
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    style='BMI Category',
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Factors', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[0, 0].grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# Plot 2: Key Health Metrics by Occupation
df_melted = df.melt(
    id_vars=['Occupation'],
    value_vars=['Heart Rate', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP'],
    var_name='Metric',
    value_name='Value'
)
sns.stripplot(
    data=df_melted,
    x='Metric',
    y='Value',
    hue='Occupation',
    jitter=True,
    dodge=True,
    size=12,
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=axes[0, 1]
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Health Vitals by Occupation', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Health Metric')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Measured Value')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Occupation', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Plot 3: Daily Steps and Sleep Duration by BMI Category
palette3 = {'Normal': 'green', 'Overweight': 'orange', 'Obese': 'red'}
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Daily Steps',
    hue='BMI Category',
    palette=palette3,
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    dodge=False,
    alpha=0.7
)
ax2 = axes[1, 0].twinx()
sns.lineplot(
    data=df.groupby('BMI Category')['Sleep Duration'].mean().reset_index(),
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    color='#34495e',
    marker='o',
    markersize=10,
    linewidth=3,
    ax=ax2,
    label='Avg Sleep Duration'
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Activity & Sleep by BMI Category', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average Daily Steps')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax2.set_ylim(5.5, 6.5)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
axes[1, 0].get_legend().remove()

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder Distribution by Occupation
disorder_counts = df.groupby(['Occupation', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
disorder_counts.plot(
    kind='bar',
    stacked=True,
    color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'],
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    width=0.8
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Disorder prevalence by Occupation', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count of Individuals')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder')

# Final adjustments and save
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
